Likely crimes: "生产、销售不符合食品安全标准的食品罪" under Chinese Criminal Law article 144? Actually article 144: "生产、销售不符合食品安全标准的食品" (producing and selling food that does not meet safety standards). Also possibly "非法添加食品添加剂罪"? There's article 144 also covers adding non-food substances. Also "非法添加有毒有害物质的食品罪". Also maybe "非法添加食品添加剂罪" under article 144. Also "非法经营罪"? But the facts are about adding toxic non-food substances, so the crime is "生产、销售有毒有害食品罪". In Chinese law, article 144: "生产、销售不符合食品安全标准的食品" includes adding prohibited substances. So the appropriate charge: "生产、销售有毒有害食品罪". Also possibly "非法添加食品添加剂罪" is separate? Actually there is article 144, paragraph 2: "生产、销售掺有有毒有害物质的食品" is a crime. So we can list "生产、销售有毒有害食品罪". Also maybe "非法添加非食品原料罪"? But the law uses "非法添加非食品原料" as part of same article. So likely single crime.

Thus answer: [罪名]生产、销售有毒有害食品罪<eoa>
